problem.title: Reverse Linked List II
problem.problemStatement: Given the head of a singly linked list and two integers left and right, reverse the nodes from position left to position right (1-indexed). The remaining nodes outside this range must remain unchanged. Return the head of the modified linked list.
problem.input: Integer n Linked list Integer left Integer right
problem.output: The linked list after reversing the specified sublist.
